name: Timelogs Extension
description:
Track time spent on GitLab issues from the top bar: search and start issues from the menu, keep independent timers per issue, submit time to GitLab and generate monthly reports.

Requires a GitLab personal access token with the api scope, stored in the system keyring when available.

Fork of Gecka-Apps/gitlab-time-tracker used by a developer team and maintained by heno. Not affiliated with GitLab.
